'''Clue scroll (beginner)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (beginner)|beginner]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 
|text = Talk to Charlie the Tramp in Varrock.
|notes = Speak to [[Charlie the Tramp]] by the southern entrance to [[Varrock]]. He will give you a [[Charlie the Tramp/Tasks|task to complete]] in the form of a new clue scroll, consisting of bringing one of the following eight unnoted items to him:
*[[Iron ore]]
*[[Iron dagger]]
*[[Raw herring]]
*[[Raw trout]]
*[[Trout]]
*[[Pike]]
*[[Leather body]]
*[[Leather chaps]]
|map = {{Map|x=3206|y=3390|plane=0|r=4|mtype=square}}
}}

==Transportation==
[[Charlie the Tramp]] can be reached effectively via the following methods:

*[[Achievement diary cape]] teleport to [[Toby]] and run south-west.
*[[Varrock Teleport]] and run south.
*[[Chronicle]] teleport and run north-east.
*[[Combat bracelet]] teleport to the [[Champion's Guild]].
*[[Senntisten Teleport]] and run west.
